hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A valid number must contain the target digit while avoiding it as its leading symbol.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Check whether the first digit matches the prohibited target digit.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Scan remaining digits to confirm at least one instance exists.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def validDigitNumber(n: int, x: int) -> bool:
    s = str(n)
    target = str(x)
    if s[0] == target:
        return False
    return target in s
```
